title: docs(spec): state the submitBehavior.url redirect contract without naming a navigation mechanism
body:
Fixes #22655

Clause-②: no

## What was false

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` ships in the npm tarball (`files[]` carries `src/**/*.zod.ts`). Its docblock above the `submitBehavior.url` check said two things that are false at the pinned Console:

- "objectui's `FormPage` performs a **verbatim redirect** on this value" (present tense)
- "the value that reaches `window.location.assign` is this string with its tokens substituted"

At `.objectui-sha` `20c6d351ad74d2b14a93becdc134d51b91b2d2e6`, read with `git show SHA:PATH` in the objectui checkout:

- `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:2233` handles `case 'redirect'` by calling `resolveSubmitRedirect(behavior.url, …)` at `:2248`. A refused url calls `toast.error(verdict.refusal)` and still calls `setSubmitted(true)` (`:2264`–`:2266`).
- `apps/console/src/components/submitRedirect.ts:247` substitutes each `{{record.field}}` token with `encodeURIComponent(urlValue(record[field]))`.
- `FormPage.tsx:2143` calls `navigate(pendingRedirect)` from a `setTimeout` of `redirectDelayMs`, where `redirectDelayMs` is `behavior.delayMs ?? 0` (`:2140`) and `navigate` is React Router's `useNavigate()` (`:1947`). The Console's redirect arm never calls `window.location.assign`.

## Which sentences change, and which stay

The #7496 ruling (comment 5250627847) says, verbatim: "a verbatim redirect on the resolved relative path IS the intended consumption." That is point 3 of the contract. It names the destination, not a navigation mechanism. Three readings agree:

- The card's "Done when" paraphrases it as "the resolved relative path is the destination".
- The pinned Console's own `submitRedirect.ts` header restates it as "the destination is that string with its tokens substituted, and nothing else", and places point 3's consumption in that module.
- The hand-written `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx:368` (corrected in PR #22651) keeps the sentence word for word and describes the Console's mechanism in a separate paragraph.

So:

- **Changed (`view.zod.ts:4075`–`:4095`).** The present-tense `FormPage` sentence is now marked as history: "History, as it stood when #7496 was ruled: objectui's `FormPage` handed this value, as authored, to a browser-level navigation …". This matches the pinned `FormPage.tsx` header, which says the redirect "was consumed as a browser-level navigation on the authored string". The `window.location.assign` clause is gone. Point 3 now reads "the destination is this string with its tokens substituted, and nothing else". A new sentence follows it: the ruling fixes the destination, and the navigation mechanism belongs to each consumer.
- **Unchanged.** The `url` `.describe()` (point 3, now `:4613`) and the `submitBehavior` `.describe()`. Neither is false, so the generated reference pages do not move, and `check:docs` stays clean (below).
- **Why the docblock names no mechanism instead of the current one.** At the pin there are two consumers with two mechanisms. The Console's `FormPage` navigates through React Router. `@object-ui/plugin-form` (`ObjectForm`, `WizardForm`) uses a host-injected navigate when there is one, and `window.location.assign` otherwise (`packages/plugin-form/src/submitRedirectNavigation.ts:109` and `:112`). Naming either would be true of only one consumer.

In `view-submit-redirect-url.test.ts`, the header's present-tense "`FormPage` redirects **verbatim**" sentence gets the same correction. Its list of ruled points keeps "verbatim redirect on the resolved path" and adds the gloss "(the destination, not a navigation mechanism)". The section heading, now `:247` ("Ruled bullet 3 — verbatim redirect on the resolved relative path"), quotes the ruling's point 3 and already matches the docblock, so it is unchanged. The comment at `:264` ("would break `FormPage`'s read") is still true at the pin, because `FormPage` hands `behavior.url` to `resolveSubmitRedirect(url: string, …)` as a string. It is unchanged too.

There is no contract change: no executable line moved, so the accept set of `submitBehavior.url` is the same.

## Changeset

`.changeset/22655-submit-redirect-docblock.md` is a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`. The edited `.zod.ts` is in the published tarball; the test file is not.

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/plugin-form` still falls back to `window.location.assign` when a host injects no navigate. This is an objectui-side ruling recorded in that file's header, not a defect. It is listed here only because it is why the docblock names no mechanism. Carrier: none.
- The released `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` entry still says "the renderer still redirects verbatim". That was true when the entry was released, and release-owned text is not edited in a code PR.
- `origin/main` moved to `9f159397fb` after this branch was cut. `git diff --stat HEAD...origin/main -- packages/spec content/docs/references` is empty: nothing this diff touches or regenerates moved. The merge ref is for CI to validate.
